$$
\begin{aligned}

&= \sqrt{(4)^2+(3)^2} \\
&= \sqrt{16+9} \\
&= 5
\end{aligned}
$$

In $\bigtriangleup AHB$ we have $\angle AHB=90^\circ$, $AH=3.5$ and $BH=0.5$. So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
AB &= \sqrt{AH^2+BH^2} \\
&= \sqrt{(\frac{7}{2})^2+(\frac{1}{2})^2} \\
&= \sqrt{\frac{49}{4}+\frac{1}{4}} \\
&= \frac{5 \sqrt{2}}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$
